posts.text: Houston’s George Bush Airport opened a prayer room catering to Muslim travelers, which includes prayer rugs, a copy of the Quran, and a washing station.  Atlanta airport now offers one prayer a week for Muslim passengers.  And people like toribranum are losing their mind over this because the faith and religion does not meet their expectations.  Is this what tolerance in America looks like?

Victor J Glover, the pilot of the Artemis II, is being celebrated as the first Black American on a moon mission.  But people like @Grace Unfiltered think that we need to stop celebrating Black achievements. The reason we have to celebrate the achievements of Black Americans is because the system is designed to make it more difficult for People of Color to win or even compete in certain areas.  Equity is also about celebrating victories.

Celebrating the failure to pass a law that would have prevented cousins from marrying each other only because democratic lawmakers were in favor of it is weird, but that’s what people like @Ø₣₣ƗĆƗΔŁ MΛGΛMΣG⁴⁷👊🏻🇺🇸🦄 are doing.

Trump’s spiritual adviser, Paula White-Cain, used an Easter message to compare President Trump’s life and struggles to those of Jesus, saying that both were betrayed and both were arrested.  Paula White-Cain continued “Mr. President, no one has paid the price like you have paid the price.”
Also “too” and not “to”.  message that’s unacceptable at this day and age. Justice and equality mean nothing if we’re still sending these messages.

President Trump posted on social media that the United States is the only country that offers birthright citizenship.  That’s not true. There are dozens of countries, many of them in the americas and including Mexico and Canada, that have codified unrestricted birthright citizenship rights, regardless of the parents’ status.
